messages.content: Who is the convener of the Computer Science program?

The published convener for the Computer Science BS program is Scott Frees. The Computer Science 4+1 listing also names Scott Frees as its convener. [Ramapo Programs](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/TS-BS-CMPS) [Ramapo Programs](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/TS-BS-PMCS)

parts.text: The Computer Science BS program record lists Scott Frees as the convener.
I wasn’t able to retrieve a verified directory contact record for his email in this turn, so I can’t confirm the address from campus evidence right now.

fields.description: Ramapo College offers students the ability to begin the Master of Science in Computer Science (MSCS) program while still an undergraduate. This accelerates their graduate program and allows them to complete their MSCS in one additional year after earning their 4-year Bachelor’s degree. This five-year program is designed for students enrolled in Computer Science, Data Science, and Mathematics undergraduate programs. Students completing Bachelor’s degrees in other disciplines may also contact the Program Director for assistance in designing a 5-year plan for their specific situation.
